רכש ציבורי בטייוואן: אותה מחלוקת בגישור ובבוררות
קבלן שינה בגישור תביעה כספית לבקשה להארכת מועד, ואז חזר לדרוש כסף בבוררות. בית המשפט העליון בטייוואן קבע שלמחלוקת הכספית המסוימת לא היה בסיס מוסכם או חוקי לבוררות.
קסדת עבודה, תוכניות וקלסרים על שולחן לצד דגם של גשר
סצנה בדיונית
האם כישלון הגישור בחוזה ציבורי בטייוואן מספיק כדי לפתוח בבוררות?

לא כשלעצמו. במסלול החוקי הנדון נדרשת מחלוקת על עבודות בנייה או שירותים טכניים, המלצה או הצעת הסדר של הוועדה לגבי אותה מחלוקת, וכישלון הגישור בשל אי־הסכמת הרשות. המחלוקת המועברת לבוררות צריכה להיות זו שנדונה בהליך הזה. הסכם בוררות נפרד עשוי לספק בסיס אחר.
האם כל שינוי בסכום או בנימוק המשפטי יוצר מחלוקת חדשה?

לא בהכרח. במקרה הנדון התביעה הכספית הוחלפה בבקשה להארכת מועד, ולאחר המלצה שעסקה בהארכה הוגשה שוב תביעה כספית. יש להשוות את העובדות, את הסעד המבוקש ואת מסמכי הגישור. גם זהות מספר הפרויקט אינה מוכיחה לבדה שמדובר באותה מחלוקת.

source.title: When a Taiwan Public-Works Claim Changes Before Arbitration
source.summary: A contractor lost a Taiwan public-works award after changing its claim. Failed mediation must cover the dispute that relies on the statutory arbitration route.

faq.q: Does unsuccessful mediation automatically allow arbitration against a Taiwan public entity?
faq.a: No. The statutory route for construction works and technical services requires unsuccessful mediation because the entity did not agree to the procurement review board's recommendation or proposal. The concrete dispute submitted to arbitration must be assessed against that mediation record. A separate arbitration agreement may provide another basis.

faq.q: Did the Supreme Court decide that every change in a claim defeats arbitration?
faq.a: No. This case involved a return to a money claim after a recommendation concerning an extension of time. It does not establish that every revised amount or legal argument creates a different dispute. The facts, relief and procedural documents need comparison.

sourcePassages.text: An arbitration award for NT$44,417,150 did not survive a Taiwan hospital contractor's court proceedings. The contractor had obtained a mediation recommendation about extra time, then pursued money in arbitration without a recommendation on that changed claim. The Supreme Court's explanation of judgment 106年度台上字第723號 identifies that gap as decisive.

On July 12, 2017, the Supreme Court dismissed the contractor's appeal. The annulment stood. Its explanation expressly records that the case was final. The problem was the absence of an agreed or statutorily deemed arbitration agreement for the concrete money dispute.
The contractor's request changed during mediation:
Stage
Relief and procedural record
Initial application
Monetary compensation was sought.
Amended application
The claim became a request for an extension of time.
Board recommendation
The board addressed the extension; the public entity did not agree.
Later claim
The contractor returned to monetary compensation, which received no recommendation or proposal before arbitration.

A certificate of unsuccessful mediation did not fill the gap. As the court explained, the entity needed an opportunity to accept or reject a recommendation on the particular dispute. The Supreme Court corrected the lower court's reasoning about which version of the law applied, while preserving its decision to annul the award.

Government Procurement Act Article 85-1 allows contract-performance disputes to be taken to the Complaint Review Board for Government Procurement for mediation. A public entity cannot refuse a supplier's mediation application. For construction works and technical services, the board must offer a mediation recommendation or proposal; if mediation fails because the entity disagrees with it, the entity cannot refuse the supplier's referral to arbitration.

Statutory consent has those limits. In the hospital case, the court found neither an agreed arbitration clause nor the facts needed for statutory consent. The court identified the absence of an arbitration agreement under Arbitration Act Article 40(1)(2) as the ground for annulment.

Contract classification comes first. Today's Article 85-1 covers construction works and technical services; that does not place every equipment purchase or other public-sector contract within this particular route. A separate arbitration clause may already govern.

The US International Trade Administration's September 30, 2026 energy report describes anticipated Taiwanese power and grid procurements in late 2026 and 2027, including opportunities for US suppliers. These are planned opportunities. The report does not establish that a particular tender has opened, that a company qualifies or that its eventual contract will count as construction or technical services.

For a bidder, the dispute clause and procurement category belong in the initial contract review. For a contractor already facing delay, the distinction becomes practical when a schedule request develops into a claim for additional costs. A claims team may regard both as the same commercial problem while the procedural record identifies different relief.

Has the board addressed the payment claim now being drafted for arbitration? The answer should come from the application and its amendments, the recommendation or proposal, the entity's response and the intended arbitration demand. A general statement that “mediation failed” leaves out the comparison that mattered in this judgment.

Changing a figure does not necessarily create a different dispute. Neither does refining a legal argument. Conversely, reusing the same project number does not answer the question. The scope requires a reading of the actual facts and relief; the 2017 decision concerned the documented move between time relief and monetary compensation.

When those documents leave a gap, counsel can assess whether an agreed arbitration basis exists or whether further mediation is needed for the proposed claim. A Taiwan contract-dispute inquiry can start with the project category, the relief sought and the next procedural date. The file to assemble is the sequence of applications, amendments and responses that led to the unsuccessful mediation.

targetPassages.text: 44,417,150 דולר טייוואני חדש נפסקו בבוררות לטובת קבלן בפרויקט של בית חולים. פסק הבוררות בוטל. ההמלצה שניתנה קודם לכן בגישור עסקה במשך העבודה, ואילו בבוררות נדרש תשלום כספי שלא היתה לגביו הסכמה תקפה לבוררות.

הרשות הציבורית ביקשה לבטל את הפסק, והקבלן ערער על הביטול. הודעת בית המשפט העליון בטייוואן מתארת את דחיית ערעורו בתיק 106年度台上字第723號 ביום 12 ביולי 2017; ביטול פסק הבוררות נעשה סופי. הסכום שנפסק אינו ראיה לכך ששולם בפועל.
בתחילת הגישור ביקש הקבלן כסף, אך במהלך הדיון החליף את הסעד המבוקש בהארכת המועד להשלמת העבודה. הוועדה המליצה על הארכה. הרשות לא הסכימה להמלצה, ולאחר מכן פנה הקבלן לבוררות וביקש שוב כסף.
שלב
הסעד שהועמד לדיון
הבקשה המקורית לגישור
תשלום כספי.
שינוי הבקשה במהלך הגישור
הארכת המועד להשלמת העבודה.
המלצת הוועדה
הארכת מועד, שהרשות לא קיבלה.
הבקשה לבוררות
חזרה לתשלום כספי.
בתיק היה אישור שהגישור נכשל. הוא לא השלים את ההליך שהיה חסר לגבי הדרישה הכספית. לפי ההסבר הרשמי לפסק הדין, הרשות צריכה לקבל הזדמנות להסכים או להתנגד להמלצה הנוגעת למחלוקת המסוימת שתועבר לבוררות.
בית המשפט העליון תיקן את הנמקת הערכאה הקודמת בעניין נוסח החוק שהיה צריך להחיל, אך הותיר את תוצאת הביטול על כנה. הותרת הביטול על כנו אינה מלמדת שכל נימוק של הערכאה הקודמת אומץ.
סעיף 85-1 לחוק הרכש הציבורי בטייוואן מאפשר לפנות לגישור בוועדה לבירור תלונות בתחום הרכש כאשר הצדדים אינם מצליחים ליישב מחלוקת על ביצוע חוזה. אם הספק מבקש גישור, הרשות אינה רשאית לסרב.

בגישור על עבודות בנייה או שירותים טכניים, הוועדה חייבת לתת המלצה או הצעת הסדר הנוגעת למחלוקת. אם הגישור נכשל משום שהרשות לא הסכימה להמלצה או להצעה, הרשות אינה יכולה לסרב להעברת אותה מחלוקת לבוררות ביוזמת הספק. נדרשת התאמה בין ההליכים. אין די בכך ששניהם נוגעים לאותו אתר בנייה.

בפרויקט בית החולים לא היתה גם תניית בוררות חוזית נפרדת שכיסתה את התביעה הכספית. התנאים להסכמה מכוח החוק לא התקיימו. עילת הביטול במקרה הזה היתה העדר הסכם בוררות, לפי סעיף 40, פסקה ראשונה, פרט 2 לחוק הבוררות.
המסלול המסוים בסעיף 85-1 מתייחס לעבודות בנייה ולשירותים טכניים. רכישת ציוד או חוזה ציבורי מסוג אחר אינם נכללים בו אוטומטית; תניית בוררות עצמאית בחוזה דורשת בדיקה נפרדת.

איזו בקשה הוועדה באמת בחנה? כדי להשיב אפשר להניח זה לצד זה את הבקשה הראשונה, את תיקוניה, את המלצת הוועדה או הצעתה, את תשובת הרשות ואת טיוטת הדרישה לבוררות. סיבת העיכוב עשויה להישאר זהה גם כשהסעד המבוקש משתנה.

עדכון סכום אינו יוצר תמיד מחלוקת חדשה. גם הבהרת נימוק משפטי אינה מוכיחה זאת לבדה. בפסק הדין הזה נבחן המעבר המתועד מכסף להארכת מועד ובחזרה לכסף, ולכן השוואה בתיק אחר צריכה להתייחס לתוכן הבקשות ולתוצאה שכל אחת מבקשת להשיג.

מינהל הסחר הבינלאומי של ארצות הברית פרסם ב-30 בספטמבר 2026 סקירה של ענף האנרגיה בטייוואן. היא מציגה הזדמנויות לספקים אמריקאים ברכש מתוכנן של תשתיות אנרגיה ורשתות חשמל לקראת סוף 2026 וב-2027. אלה תוכניות לרכש עתידי. הסקירה אינה אישור שמכרז מסוים נפתח, שחברה מסוימת זכאית להשתתף בו או שהחוזה שלה שייך לקטגוריה שבסעיף 85-1.

בבחינת חוזה לפני הצעה אפשר לחבר בין סיווג הרכש לבין תניית יישוב הסכסוכים. לפנייה לגבי מחלוקת קיימת ניתן לציין בעמוד יצירת הקשר באנגלית את סוג הפרויקט, הסעד המבוקש והמועד הקרוב. המסמכים שמבהירים מתי השתנתה הבקשה ולאיזו הצעה הרשות השיבה הם שיאפשרו לבחון את רצף ההליך.
הודעת בית המשפט נבדקה ב-25 באוקטובר 2026, והחקיקה והסקירה הרשמיות ב-26 באוקטובר. הדיון מתייחס למסלול הבוררות המתואר ואינו קובע סמכות או מועד להגשת הליך בחוזה מסוים.
בית המשפט העליון, הודעה על תיק 106年度台上字第723號, 12 ביולי 2017: שינוי הסעד והביטול הסופי של פסק הבוררות.
חוק הרכש הציבורי, סעיף 85-1: גישור ובוררות במחלוקות ביצוע.
חוק הבוררות, סעיף 40: עילת העדר הסכם בפסקה הראשונה, פרט 2.

לא כשלעצמו. במסלול החוקי הנדון נדרשת מחלוקת על עבודות בנייה או שירותים טכניים, המלצה או הצעת הסדר של הוועדה לגבי אותה מחלוקת, וכישלון הגישור בשל אי־הסכמת הרשות. המחלוקת המועברת לבוררות צריכה להיות זו שנדונה בהליך הזה. הסכם בוררות נפרד עשוי לספק בסיס אחר.

[Government Procurement Act Article 85-1](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030057) allows contract-performance disputes to be taken to the Complaint Review Board for Government Procurement for mediation. A public entity cannot refuse a supplier's mediation application. For construction works and technical services, the board must offer a mediation recommendation or proposal; if mediation fails because the entity disagrees with it, the entity cannot refuse the supplier's referral to arbitration.

Statutory consent has those limits. In the hospital case, the court found neither an agreed arbitration clause nor the facts needed for statutory consent. The court identified the absence of an arbitration agreement under [Arbitration Act Article 40(1)(2)](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=I0020001) as the ground for annulment.

Contract classification comes first. Today's Article 85-1 covers construction works and technical services; that does not place every equipment purchase or other public-sector contract within this particular route. A separate arbitration clause may already govern.

## Why this matters for US project teams now

The US International Trade Administration's [September 30, 2026 energy report](https://www.trade.gov/market-intelligence/taiwan-energy-industry) describes anticipated Taiwanese power and grid procurements in late 2026 and 2027, including opportunities for US suppliers. These are planned opportunities. The report does not establish that a particular tender has opened, that a company qualifies or that its eventual contract will count as construction or technical services.

For a bidder, the dispute clause and procurement category belong in the initial contract review. For a contractor already facing delay, the distinction becomes practical when a schedule request develops into a claim for additional costs. A claims team may regard both as the same commercial problem while the procedural record identifies different relief.

Has the board addressed the payment claim now being drafted for arbitration? The answer should come from the application and its amendments, the recommendation or proposal, the entity's response and the intended arbitration demand. A general statement that “mediation failed” leaves out the comparison that mattered in this judgment.

Changing a figure does not necessarily create a different dispute. Neither does refining a legal argument. Conversely, reusing the same project number does not answer the question. The scope requires a reading of the actual facts and relief; the 2017 decision concerned the documented move between time relief and monetary compensation.

When those documents leave a gap, counsel can assess whether an agreed arbitration basis exists or whether further mediation is needed for the proposed claim. A [Taiwan contract-dispute inquiry](/en/contact) can start with the project category, the relief sought and the next procedural date. The file to assemble is the sequence of applications, amendments and responses that led to the unsuccessful mediation.

Sources and current statutory text checked October 25, 2026. The case account relies on the Supreme Court's official explanation. This article addresses one route to arbitration and does not determine a particular contract's forum or filing deadlines.

44,417,150 דולר טייוואני חדש נפסקו בבוררות לטובת קבלן בפרויקט של בית חולים. פסק הבוררות בוטל. ההמלצה שניתנה קודם לכן בגישור עסקה במשך העבודה, ואילו בבוררות נדרש תשלום כספי שלא היתה לגביו הסכמה תקפה לבוררות.

הרשות הציבורית ביקשה לבטל את הפסק, והקבלן ערער על הביטול. [הודעת בית המשפט העליון בטייוואן](https://jirs.judicial.gov.tw/GNNWS/NNWSS002.asp?id=274693) מתארת את דחיית ערעורו בתיק 106年度台上字第723號 ביום 12 ביולי 2017; ביטול פסק הבוררות נעשה סופי. הסכום שנפסק אינו ראיה לכך ששולם בפועל.

## מה התבקש בכל שלב?

בתחילת הגישור ביקש הקבלן כסף, אך במהלך הדיון החליף את הסעד המבוקש בהארכת המועד להשלמת העבודה. הוועדה המליצה על הארכה. הרשות לא הסכימה להמלצה, ולאחר מכן פנה הקבלן לבוררות וביקש שוב כסף.

| שלב | הסעד שהועמד לדיון |
|---|---|
| הבקשה המקורית לגישור | תשלום כספי. |
| שינוי הבקשה במהלך הגישור | הארכת המועד להשלמת העבודה. |
| המלצת הוועדה | הארכת מועד, שהרשות לא קיבלה. |
| הבקשה לבוררות | חזרה לתשלום כספי. |

בתיק היה אישור שהגישור נכשל. הוא לא השלים את ההליך שהיה חסר לגבי הדרישה הכספית. לפי [ההסבר הרשמי לפסק הדין](https://jirs.judicial.gov.tw/GNNWS/NNWSS002.asp?id=274693), הרשות צריכה לקבל הזדמנות להסכים או להתנגד להמלצה הנוגעת למחלוקת המסוימת שתועבר לבוררות.

בית המשפט העליון תיקן את הנמקת הערכאה הקודמת בעניין נוסח החוק שהיה צריך להחיל, אך הותיר את תוצאת הביטול על כנה. הותרת הביטול על כנו אינה מלמדת שכל נימוק של הערכאה הקודמת אומץ.

## התנאים למסלול שהרשות אינה יכולה לסרב לו

[סעיף 85-1 לחוק הרכש הציבורי בטייוואן](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030057) מאפשר לפנות לגישור בוועדה לבירור תלונות בתחום הרכש כאשר הצדדים אינם מצליחים ליישב מחלוקת על ביצוע חוזה. אם הספק מבקש גישור, הרשות אינה רשאית לסרב.

בגישור על עבודות בנייה או שירותים טכניים, הוועדה חייבת לתת המלצה או הצעת הסדר הנוגעת למחלוקת. אם הגישור נכשל משום שהרשות לא הסכימה להמלצה או להצעה, הרשות אינה יכולה לסרב להעברת אותה מחלוקת לבוררות ביוזמת הספק. נדרשת התאמה בין ההליכים. אין די בכך ששניהם נוגעים לאותו אתר בנייה.

בפרויקט בית החולים לא היתה גם תניית בוררות חוזית נפרדת שכיסתה את התביעה הכספית. התנאים להסכמה מכוח החוק לא התקיימו. עילת הביטול במקרה הזה היתה העדר הסכם בוררות, לפי [סעיף 40, פסקה ראשונה, פרט 2 לחוק הבוררות](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=I0020001).

המסלול המסוים בסעיף 85-1 מתייחס לעבודות בנייה ולשירותים טכניים. רכישת ציוד או חוזה ציבורי מסוג אחר אינם נכללים בו אוטומטית; תניית בוררות עצמאית בחוזה דורשת בדיקה נפרדת.

## מהארכת לוח זמנים לדרישה כספית

איזו בקשה הוועדה באמת בחנה? כדי להשיב אפשר להניח זה לצד זה את הבקשה הראשונה, את תיקוניה, את המלצת הוועדה או הצעתה, את תשובת הרשות ואת טיוטת הדרישה לבוררות. סיבת העיכוב עשויה להישאר זהה גם כשהסעד המבוקש משתנה.

עדכון סכום אינו יוצר תמיד מחלוקת חדשה. גם הבהרת נימוק משפטי אינה מוכיחה זאת לבדה. בפסק הדין הזה נבחן המעבר המתועד מכסף להארכת מועד ובחזרה לכסף, ולכן השוואה בתיק אחר צריכה להתייחס לתוכן הבקשות ולתוצאה שכל אחת מבקשת להשיג.

[מינהל הסחר הבינלאומי של ארצות הברית פרסם ב-30 בספטמבר 2026 סקירה של ענף האנרגיה בטייוואן](https://www.trade.gov/market-intelligence/taiwan-energy-industry). היא מציגה הזדמנויות לספקים אמריקאים ברכש מתוכנן של תשתיות אנרגיה ורשתות חשמל לקראת סוף 2026 וב-2027. אלה תוכניות לרכש עתידי. הסקירה אינה אישור שמכרז מסוים נפתח, שחברה מסוימת זכאית להשתתף בו או שהחוזה שלה שייך לקטגוריה שבסעיף 85-1.

בבחינת חוזה לפני הצעה אפשר לחבר בין סיווג הרכש לבין תניית יישוב הסכסוכים. לפנייה לגבי מחלוקת קיימת ניתן לציין ב[עמוד יצירת הקשר באנגלית](/en/contact) את סוג הפרויקט, הסעד המבוקש והמועד הקרוב. המסמכים שמבהירים מתי השתנתה הבקשה ולאיזו הצעה הרשות השיבה הם שיאפשרו לבחון את רצף ההליך.

הודעת בית המשפט נבדקה ב-25 באוקטובר 2026, והחקיקה והסקירה הרשמיות ב-26 באוקטובר. הדיון מתייחס למסלול הבוררות המתואר ואינו קובע סמכות או מועד להגשת הליך בחוזה מסוים.

- [חוק הרכש הציבורי, סעיף 85-1](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030057): גישור ובוררות במחלוקות ביצוע.
- [חוק הבוררות, סעיף 40](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=I0020001): עילת העדר הסכם בפסקה הראשונה, פרט 2.

targetFields.text: מי ידע על הזיהום במפעל בטייוואן, ומי החליט להעביר את הכסף?
זיהום במפעל בטייוואן ואחריות חברת האם
בהליך על חשיפת עובדי מפעל לחומרים כימיים נבחנו ידיעת החברות השולטות, השפעתן על הפעילות והעברות נכסים. האחריות לא נבעה מעצם הבעלות, וחלקים מהתיק הוחזרו לדיון נוסף.
צנצנת דגימת קרקע ומחברת על שולחן מתקפל מחוץ למבנה תעשייתי ישן
סצנה בדיונית
האם חברת אם זרה אחראית לזיהום רק משום שהיא בעלת החברה בטייוואן?

לא זו היתה ההנמקה במקרה הנדון. ההודעה הרשמית עוסקת בשליטה בפעילות, בידיעה על הזיהום, באי־יידוע העובדים ובאי־טיפול בסיכון, ובהעברות נכסים שנועדו להתחמק מאחריות. צריך לבחון את המעשים ואת הדין החל, ולא רק את תרשים האחזקות.
האם פסק הדין משנת 2018 סיים את כל תביעות הפיצויים הקשורות למפעל?
לא. החלקים הנוגעים ל-246 תובעים בוטלו והוחזרו לדיון, ואילו הערעורים הנוגעים ל-262 תובעים נדחו. אלה תוצאות שונות, שאינן שקולות לדחיית כל התביעות המקוריות או לסיום כל ההתדיינויות הקשורות.
אילו רישומים מועילים לאחר בדיקת נאותות סביבתית ברכישת חברה?

אפשר לשמור את הדוח, את רשימת מקבליו, את שאלות ההמשך ואת ההחלטות על חשיפת עובדים לחומרים כימיים ועל טיפול בזיהום. בהעברת נכסים מאוחרת יותר יש חשיבות גם לאישורים ולבחינת המשאבים שנותרו. עצם שמירת התיק אינה מוכיחה שהפעולות היו חוקיות.

source.title: Taiwan Factory Pollution: What the Parent Companies Knew
source.summary: A Taiwan pollution judgment linked parent-company liability to control, knowledge and asset transfers. Acquisition diligence needs a record of the response.

faq.q: Does owning a Taiwan subsidiary make its foreign parent liable for pollution claims?
faq.a: Ownership alone was not the basis of the ruling discussed here. The court's explanation describes control, knowledge of contamination, failure to address or disclose it, and asset movements intended to evade liabilities. Liability requires analysis of the particular conduct and applicable law.

faq.q: Did the 2018 Supreme Court ruling end every claim in the factory-pollution litigation?

target.title: מי ידע על הזיהום במפעל בטייוואן, ומי החליט להעביר את הכסף?
target.seoTitle: זיהום במפעל בטייוואן ואחריות חברת האם
target.summary: בהליך על חשיפת עובדי מפעל לחומרים כימיים נבחנו ידיעת החברות השולטות, השפעתן על הפעילות והעברות נכסים. האחריות לא נבעה מעצם הבעלות, וחלקים מהתיק הוחזרו לדיון נוסף.

faq.q: האם חברת אם זרה אחראית לזיהום רק משום שהיא בעלת החברה בטייוואן?
faq.a: לא זו היתה ההנמקה במקרה הנדון. ההודעה הרשמית עוסקת בשליטה בפעילות, בידיעה על הזיהום, באי־יידוע העובדים ובאי־טיפול בסיכון, ובהעברות נכסים שנועדו להתחמק מאחריות. צריך לבחון את המעשים ואת הדין החל, ולא רק את תרשים האחזקות.

faq.q: האם פסק הדין משנת 2018 סיים את כל תביעות הפיצויים הקשורות למפעל?
faq.a: לא. החלקים הנוגעים ל-246 תובעים בוטלו והוחזרו לדיון, ואילו הערעורים הנוגעים ל-262 תובעים נדחו. אלה תוצאות שונות, שאינן שקולות לדחיית כל התביעות המקוריות או לסיום כל ההתדיינויות הקשורות.

faq.q: אילו רישומים מועילים לאחר בדיקת נאותות סביבתית ברכישת חברה?
faq.a: אפשר לשמור את הדוח, את רשימת מקבליו, את שאלות ההמשך ואת ההחלטות על חשיפת עובדים לחומרים כימיים ועל טיפול בזיהום. בהעברת נכסים מאוחרת יותר יש חשיבות גם לאישורים ולבחינת המשאבים שנותרו. עצם שמירת התיק אינה מוכיחה שהפעולות היו חוקיות.

sourcePassages.text: Environmental investigations before an acquisition became part of the evidence against parent companies in a Taiwan factory-pollution case. The Supreme Court connected knowledge of contamination with operational control, the response to the danger and transfers that depleted the Taiwan company's assets. Its official explanation of judgment 107年度台上字第267號 shows why an acquisition review cannot end when the consultant delivers a report.

Issued on August 16, 2018, the decision concerned workers' chemical exposure at an electronics manufacturer and the responsibility of companies controlling that business. It did not impose liability merely because a foreign investor owned a Taiwan subsidiary.

According to the Supreme Court's explanation, the record included environmental surveys identifying contamination, knowledge within the controlling groups, failure to inform workers or remedy the problem, and capital reductions and offshore remittances intended to evade liabilities. The court upheld the reasoning that allowed the relevant claims to reach the controlling companies despite separate corporate identities.

That sequence matters to acquisition counsel. A report's distribution list can identify who knew about the problem. Board papers and operational instructions can show who could decide how to respond. Later remittance approvals may need to be read against both. Treating those records as unrelated workstreams makes the group's own decisions harder to reconstruct.

The report is a starting point. A useful review asks who investigated the exposure concern, what further work was commissioned and how the findings affected decisions about the operating company's resources. It should record unanswered questions as unanswered. An optimistic closing presentation should not erase the underlying technical findings or the people responsible for following them up.

For 246 claimants, the Supreme Court vacated the relevant portions and sent them back for further proceedings. Appeals concerning 262 claimants were dismissed. The remand included shortcomings in the analysis of injury, evidence and authority to pursue claims. Those figures and limits appear in the court's disposition summary.

The split prevents a broad reading of the case. Remand did not decide that all affected people lacked a claim, and the dismissed appeals did not resolve every part of the wider litigation. A transaction team assessing historical exposure needs to identify the particular proceedings and their status before estimating an obligation. A headline about a single court date cannot supply that assessment.

Taiwan's Company Act Article 154 generally limits a shareholder's responsibility to payment for its shares. Paragraph 2 provides an exception where a shareholder abuses the company's legal personality, causes it to incur a specific debt that is clearly difficult to repay, and the circumstances are serious enough to make shareholder liability necessary.

Each condition matters. A shareholder relationship, an unpaid debt or an environmental finding alone does not state the whole statutory test. Nor should the statute be treated as the sole explanation for the court's treatment of historical conduct in the 2018 case. That decision examined the controlling companies' conduct and the basis for looking beyond separate legal identity.

Investors comparing entity structures can find the ordinary starting point in the subsidiary and branch article. The pollution dispute adds a question that incorporation documents cannot answer: how did the group actually use its control when it learned about the risk?
USTR's February 2026 fact sheet describes the two sides' intention to facilitate cross-border investment and possible US support for private investment financing in Taiwan, subject to applicable law.

Before approving a distribution, capital reduction or exit transfer, the relevant decision-makers should have an assessment of identified exposure, unresolved claims and the resources that will remain in the Taiwan company. The legal review must address the proposed transaction itself. No document label establishes that a transfer is lawful, and a report sitting unread in a data room does not establish a response to its findings.

For a Taiwan corporate or disputes inquiry, the initial description can identify the transaction, the Taiwan entity and any scheduled transfer or closing date. Technical reports and sensitive worker information can be handled through an agreed delivery process. The immediate records to preserve are the original findings, the decisions they prompted and the approvals for any subsequent movement of assets.

Official sources checked October 25, 2026. This article examines one identified 2018 ruling through the Supreme Court's explanation and the current statutory provision; it is not a history of every related case or an assessment of a particular investor's liability.

targetPassages.text: מי קיבל את דוח הבדיקה הסביבתית לפני רכישת המפעל? התשובה יכולה לקשור בין ידיעה על סיכון לבין החלטות שהתקבלו שנים אחר כך. בתביעת עובדי מפעל אלקטרוניקה בטייוואן נבחנו הקשר הזה, השליטה בפעילות והוצאת כספים מהחברה.
הודעת בית המשפט העליון בתיק 107年度台上字第267號 מתארת פסק דין מ-16 באוגוסט 2018 בעניין חשיפה לחומרים כימיים. העובדה שהבעלים היו זרים לא הספיקה. ההנמקה עסקה בידיעת החברות השולטות ובפעולותיהן.

לפי ההודעה הרשמית, בדיקות סביבתיות הצביעו על הזיהום והחברות השולטות ידעו עליו. היכולת להשפיע על הפעילות, אי־מסירת מידע לעובדים והעדר טיפול מתאים נבחנו לצד הפחתות הון והעברת כספים אל מחוץ לטייוואן. להעברות יוחסה תכלית של התחמקות מאחריות. ההפרדה המשפטית בין החברות לא מנעה את קבלת ההנמקה לאחריותן בנסיבות האלה.

רשימת התפוצה של הדוח מלמדת למי הגיע המידע. הוראות תפעול ופרוטוקולים עשויים להראות מי יכול היה להגיב עליו. צירוף אישורי העברה מאוחרים מאפשר לבדוק אם החלטות על נכסים התקבלו כאשר הסיכון והחשיפה כבר היו ידועים למקבליהן.

סגירת עסקת הרכישה אינה פותרת ממצא שנותר פתוח בדוח. אפשר לתעד מי בחן את חשיפת העובדים, אילו אמצעי טיפול נשקלו ומה היתה השפעתם על המשאבים שיישארו בחברה. תקציר חיובי של השלמת העסקה אינו מסביר כשלעצמו כיצד טופלו הממצאים הטכניים.

בית המשפט העליון ביטל את החלקים הנוגעים ל-246 תובעים והחזיר אותם לערכאה הקודמת לדיון נוסף. הערעורים הנוגעים ל-262 תובעים נדחו. ההודעה הרשמית מפרטת ליקויים בבחינת הנזק, הראיות והסמכות להעלות תביעות, שהצריכו את הדיון הנוסף.

לא כל ההליכים הסתיימו. החזרת חלק מהתיק אינה קביעה שלאותם עובדים אין עילה, ודחיית ערעור אינה זהה לדחיית כל תביעה מקורית. בבדיקת התחייבויות של חברה נדרשת הבחנה בין החלקים שהוכרעו לבין שאלות שעדיין ממתינות להכרעה.

סעיף 154 לחוק החברות בטייוואן מגביל ככלל את אחריות בעל המניות לחובתו לשלם עבור מניותיו. בפסקה השנייה נקבע חריג: כאשר שימוש לרעה באישיות המשפטית של החברה גורם לה לשאת בחוב מסוים, קיים קושי ברור בפירעונו, והנסיבות חמורות במידה המחייבת להטיל על בעל המניות את חובת הפירעון, בעל המניות חב באותו חוב.

התנאים מצטברים. חוב שלא שולם או ממצא זיהום אחד אינם ממלאים לבדם את כולם. הנוסח הנוכחי גם אינו בסיס יחיד שיש להחיל בדיעבד על כל פעולה בפרשה הישנה; ההכרעה המתוארת עוסקת במעשים שבגללם לא התקבלה ההסתמכות על האישיות הנפרדת.
בבחירת מבנה פעילות אפשר להיעזר בהסבר על חברת בת לעומת סניף בטייוואן. להערכת אחריות במקרה של זיהום דרושים לצד מסמכי ההתאגדות גם רישומים על האופן שבו הופעלה השליטה לאחר שנודע הסיכון.

דף העובדות של נציג הסחר של ארצות הברית מפברואר 2026 מתאר כוונות להקל על השקעות בין ארצות הברית לטייוואן. בין היתר מוזכר כי הצד האמריקאי ישקול, במקרים מתאימים ובהתאם לדין החל, תמיכה במימון השקעות פרטיות בענפים חיוניים בטייוואן עם שותפים אמריקאים מהמגזר הפרטי. זו כוונה מותנית. היא אינה מקנה לכל משקיע זכות לקבל מימון.

לפני חלוקת רווחים, הפחתת הון או העברת כספים במסגרת יציאה מהשקעה, אפשר לבחון יחד חשיפות ידועות, תביעות שטרם הוכרעו ואת המשאבים שיישארו בחברה הטייוואנית. תיק מסודר מסייע לשחזר החלטות, אך אינו הופך העברה מתוכננת לחוקית.

לבדיקה של עסקה מסוימת ניתן לציין בעמוד יצירת הקשר באנגלית את החברה בטייוואן, הפעולה המתוכננת ומועד הסגירה או ההעברה. את הדרך למסירת דוחות טכניים ונתוני עובדים רגישים אפשר לתאם בנפרד. הרצף שמחבר את הממצא הראשון, התגובה לו ואישור העברת הנכסים מאפשר להבין מי ידע מה בזמן ההחלטה.
הודעת בית המשפט נבדקה ב-25 באוקטובר 2026, והחקיקה ודף העובדות ב-26 באוקטובר. הדיון אינו קובע את תוצאת כל ההליכים הקשורים למפעל או את אחריותו של משקיע מסוים.
בית המשפט העליון, הודעה על תיק 107年度台上字第267號, 16 באוגוסט 2018: ידיעה, שליטה, העברות נכסים ותוצאות ההליכים.
חוק החברות, סעיף 154: אחריות בעל מניות והתנאים לחריג.
נציג הסחר של ארצות הברית, דף העובדות על הסכם הסחר עם טייוואן, פברואר 2026.

Nor should the statute be treated as the sole explanation for the court's treatment of historical conduct in the 2018 case. That decision examined the controlling companies' conduct and the basis for looking beyond separate legal identity.

Investors comparing entity structures can find the ordinary starting point in the [subsidiary and branch article](/en/columns/taiwan-company-subsidiary-vs-branch). The pollution dispute adds a question that incorporation documents cannot answer: how did the group actually use its control when it learned about the risk?

## A current investment plan needs a response record

[USTR's February 2026 fact sheet](https://ustr.gov/about/policy-offices/press-office/fact-sheets/2026/february/fact-sheet-us-taiwan-agreement-reciprocal-trade) describes the two sides' intention to facilitate cross-border investment and possible US support for private investment financing in Taiwan, subject to applicable law.

Before approving a distribution, capital reduction or exit transfer, the relevant decision-makers should have an assessment of identified exposure, unresolved claims and the resources that will remain in the Taiwan company. The legal review must address the proposed transaction itself. No document label establishes that a transfer is lawful, and a report sitting unread in a data room does not establish a response to its findings.

For a [Taiwan corporate or disputes inquiry](/en/contact), the initial description can identify the transaction, the Taiwan entity and any scheduled transfer or closing date. Technical reports and sensitive worker information can be handled through an agreed delivery process. The immediate records to preserve are the original findings, the decisions they prompted and the approvals for any subsequent movement of assets.

מי קיבל את דוח הבדיקה הסביבתית לפני רכישת המפעל? התשובה יכולה לקשור בין ידיעה על סיכון לבין החלטות שהתקבלו שנים אחר כך. בתביעת עובדי מפעל אלקטרוניקה בטייוואן נבחנו הקשר הזה, השליטה בפעילות והוצאת כספים מהחברה.

[הודעת בית המשפט העליון בתיק 107年度台上字第267號](https://jirs.judicial.gov.tw/GNNWS/NNWSS002.asp?id=359523) מתארת פסק דין מ-16 באוגוסט 2018 בעניין חשיפה לחומרים כימיים. העובדה שהבעלים היו זרים לא הספיקה. ההנמקה עסקה בידיעת החברות השולטות ובפעולותיהן.

## הדוח, העובדים והנכסים שיצאו מהחברה

לפי ההודעה הרשמית, בדיקות סביבתיות הצביעו על הזיהום והחברות השולטות ידעו עליו. היכולת להשפיע על הפעילות, אי־מסירת מידע לעובדים והעדר טיפול מתאים נבחנו לצד הפחתות הון והעברת כספים אל מחוץ לטייוואן. להעברות יוחסה תכלית של התחמקות מאחריות. ההפרדה המשפטית בין החברות לא מנעה את קבלת ההנמקה לאחריותן בנסיבות האלה.

רשימת התפוצה של הדוח מלמדת למי הגיע המידע. הוראות תפעול ופרוטוקולים עשויים להראות מי יכול היה להגיב עליו. צירוף אישורי העברה מאוחרים מאפשר לבדוק אם החלטות על נכסים התקבלו כאשר הסיכון והחשיפה כבר היו ידועים למקבליהן.

סגירת עסקת הרכישה אינה פותרת ממצא שנותר פתוח בדוח. אפשר לתעד מי בחן את חשיפת העובדים, אילו אמצעי טיפול נשקלו ומה היתה השפעתם על המשאבים שיישארו בחברה. תקציר חיובי של השלמת העסקה אינו מסביר כשלעצמו כיצד טופלו הממצאים הטכניים.

## 246 תובעים לדיון נוסף, וערעורים אחרים שנדחו

בית המשפט העליון ביטל את החלקים הנוגעים ל-246 תובעים והחזיר אותם לערכאה הקודמת לדיון נוסף. הערעורים הנוגעים ל-262 תובעים נדחו. [ההודעה הרשמית](https://jirs.judicial.gov.tw/GNNWS/NNWSS002.asp?id=359523) מפרטת ליקויים בבחינת הנזק, הראיות והסמכות להעלות תביעות, שהצריכו את הדיון הנוסף.

לא כל ההליכים הסתיימו. החזרת חלק מהתיק אינה קביעה שלאותם עובדים אין עילה, ודחיית ערעור אינה זהה לדחיית כל תביעה מקורית. בבדיקת התחייבויות של חברה נדרשת הבחנה בין החלקים שהוכרעו לבין שאלות שעדיין ממתינות להכרעה.

## מתי בעל מניות חב בחוב מסוים של החברה?

[סעיף 154 לחוק החברות בטייוואן](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=J0080001&flno=154) מגביל ככלל את אחריות בעל המניות לחובתו לשלם עבור מניותיו. בפסקה השנייה נקבע חריג: כאשר שימוש לרעה באישיות המשפטית של החברה גורם לה לשאת בחוב מסוים, קיים קושי ברור בפירעונו, והנסיבות חמורות במידה המחייבת להטיל על בעל המניות את חובת הפירעון, בעל המניות חב באותו חוב.

התנאים מצטברים. חוב שלא שולם או ממצא זיהום אחד אינם ממלאים לבדם את כולם. הנוסח הנוכחי גם אינו בסיס יחיד שיש להחיל בדיעבד על כל פעולה בפרשה הישנה; ההכרעה המתוארת עוסקת במעשים שבגללם לא התקבלה ההסתמכות על האישיות הנפרדת.

בבחירת מבנה פעילות אפשר להיעזר בהסבר על [חברת בת לעומת סניף בטייוואן](/he/columns/taiwan-company-subsidiary-vs-branch). להערכת אחריות במקרה של זיהום דרושים לצד מסמכי ההתאגדות גם רישומים על האופן שבו הופעלה השליטה לאחר שנודע הסיכון.

## השקעה חדשה והמשך הטיפול בסיכון ידוע

[דף העובדות של נציג הסחר של ארצות הברית מפברואר 2026](https://ustr.gov/about/policy-offices/press-office/fact-sheets/2026/february/fact-sheet-us-taiwan-agreement-reciprocal-trade) מתאר כוונות להקל על השקעות בין ארצות הברית לטייוואן. בין היתר מוזכר כי הצד האמריקאי ישקול, במקרים מתאימים ובהתאם לדין החל, תמיכה במימון השקעות פרטיות בענפים חיוניים בטייוואן עם שותפים אמריקאים מהמגזר הפרטי. זו כוונה מותנית. היא אינה מקנה לכל משקיע זכות לקבל מימון.

לפני חלוקת רווחים, הפחתת הון או העברת כספים במסגרת יציאה מהשקעה, אפשר לבחון יחד חשיפות ידועות, תביעות שטרם הוכרעו ואת המשאבים שיישארו בחברה הטייוואנית. תיק מסודר מסייע לשחזר החלטות, אך אינו הופך העברה מתוכננת לחוקית.

לבדיקה של עסקה מסוימת ניתן לציין ב[עמוד יצירת הקשר באנגלית](/en/contact) את החברה בטייוואן, הפעולה המתוכננת ומועד הסגירה או ההעברה. את הדרך למסירת דוחות טכניים ונתוני עובדים רגישים אפשר לתאם בנפרד. הרצף שמחבר את הממצא הראשון, התגובה לו ואישור העברת הנכסים מאפשר להבין מי ידע מה בזמן ההחלטה.

הודעת בית המשפט נבדקה ב-25 באוקטובר 2026, והחקיקה ודף העובדות ב-26 באוקטובר. הדיון אינו קובע את תוצאת כל ההליכים הקשורים למפעל או את אחריותו של משקיע מסוים.

sourceEvidence.text: Did the 2018 Supreme Court ruling end every claim in the factory-pollution litigation?

No. The court vacated and remanded the portions concerning 246 claimants and dismissed the appeals concerning 262. The ruling had different outcomes for different portions of the case; it was not the conclusion of all related litigation.

Environmental investigations before an acquisition became part of the evidence against parent companies in a Taiwan factory-pollution case. The Supreme Court connected knowledge of contamination with operational control, the response to the danger and transfers that depleted the Taiwan company's assets. Its official explanation of judgment 107年度台上字第267號 shows why an acquisition review cannot end when the consultant delivers a report.

Issued on August 16, 2018, the decision concerned workers' chemical exposure at an electronics manufacturer and the responsibility of companies controlling that business. It did not impose liability merely because a foreign investor owned a Taiwan subsidiary.

For 246 claimants, the Supreme Court vacated the relevant portions and sent them back for further proceedings. Appeals concerning 262 claimants were dismissed. The remand included shortcomings in the analysis of injury, evidence and authority to pursue claims. Those figures and limits appear in the court's disposition summary.

Taiwan's Company Act Article 154 generally limits a shareholder's responsibility to payment for its shares. Paragraph 2 provides an exception where a shareholder abuses the company's legal personality, causes it to incur a specific debt that is clearly difficult to repay, and the circumstances are serious enough to make shareholder liability necessary.

Each condition matters. A shareholder relationship, an unpaid debt or an environmental finding alone does not state the whole statutory test. Nor should the statute be treated as the sole explanation for the court's treatment of historical conduct in the 2018 case. That decision examined the controlling companies' conduct and the basis for looking beyond separate legal identity.

targetFields.text: Mula sa dagdag na panahon tungo sa bayad: kapag nagbago ang habol bago ang arbitrasyon sa Taiwan
Arbitrasyon sa kontratang pampubliko ng Taiwan

Napawalang-bisa ang isang arbitration award matapos ibalik ng contractor ang habol sa pera nang walang rekomendasyon sa partikular na alitang iyon. Ipinaliwanag ng Supreme Court kung bakit kailangang tumugma sa pamamagitan ang alitang dadalhin sa arbitrasyon.
Hard hat, mga plano ng konstruksiyon at mga binder sa tabi ng modelo ng tulay
Kathang-isip na eksena
Awtomatiko na bang maaaring mag-arbitrasyon laban sa isang pampublikong entidad kapag nabigo ang pamamagitan?

Hindi. Para sa construction works at technical services, kailangang mabigo ang pamamagitan dahil hindi tinanggap ng entidad ang rekomendasyon o panukala ng procurement review board. Dapat ding ihambing sa rekord ng pamamagitan ang partikular na alitang dadalhin sa arbitrasyon. Maaaring magbigay ng hiwalay na batayan ang hiwalay na kasunduan sa arbitrasyon.
Ipinasiya ba ng Supreme Court na anumang pagbabago sa habol ay pumipigil sa arbitrasyon?

Hindi. Sa kasong ito, bumalik ang contractor sa habol na pera matapos ang rekomendasyon tungkol sa dagdag na panahon. Hindi nito itinatakda na bawat pagbabago sa halaga o legal na argumento ay lumilikha ng ibang alitan. Kailangang ihambing ang mga katotohanan, hinihinging remedyo at mga dokumento ng proseso.

source.title: When a Taiwan Public-Works Claim Changes Before Arbitration
source.summary: A contractor lost a Taiwan public-works award after changing its claim. Failed mediation must cover the dispute that relies on the statutory arbitration route.

faq.q: Does unsuccessful mediation automatically allow arbitration against a Taiwan public entity?
faq.a: No. The statutory route for construction works and technical services requires unsuccessful mediation because the entity did not agree to the procurement review board's recommendation or proposal. The concrete dispute submitted to arbitration must be assessed against that mediation record. A separate arbitration agreement may provide another basis.

faq.q: Did the Supreme Court decide that every change in a claim defeats arbitration?
faq.a: No. This case involved a return to a money claim after a recommendation concerning an extension of time. It does not establish that every revised amount or legal argument creates a different dispute. The facts, relief and procedural documents need comparison.

Nakatanggap ang contractor ng rekomendasyon tungkol sa dagdag na panahon, ngunit pera na ang hinabol nito sa arbitrasyon nang walang rekomendasyon o panukala sa bagong anyo ng habol. Sa opisyal na paliwanag sa 106年度台上字第723號, iyon ang pagkukulang na itinuring na desisibo ng Supreme Court.

Noong 12 Hulyo 2017, ibinasura ng Supreme Court ang apela ng contractor. Nanatili ang pagpapawalang-bisa sa award, at tahasang nakasaad sa paliwanag ng hukuman na pinal na ang kaso. Walang arbitration agreement na sumasaklaw sa partikular na alitan sa pera—maging napagkasunduan ito o itinuring na nabuo sa batas.
Nagbago ang hinihinging remedyo habang nagpapatuloy ang pamamagitan:
Yugto
Hinabol at naging rekord
Unang aplikasyon
Kabayarang pangsalapi.
Binagong aplikasyon
Dagdag na panahon para sa proyekto.
Rekomendasyon ng board
Tinalakay ang dagdag na panahon; hindi sumang-ayon ang pampublikong entidad.
Kasunod na habol

Hindi sapat ang sertipiko ng nabigong pamamagitan. Kailangan pa ring mabigyan ang entidad ng pagkakataong tanggapin o tanggihan ang rekomendasyon sa partikular na alitan sa pera, ayon sa paliwanag ng hukuman; ang sertipiko ay hindi nagpapatunay na natugunan iyon. Itinama ng Supreme Court ang pangangatwiran ng mababang hukuman kung aling bersiyon ng batas ang umiiral; gayunpaman, nanatili ang pagpapawalang-bisa sa award.
Magkaiba ang dalawang usapin. Ang proyekto at kontrata ay maaaring iisa, ngunit kailangan pa ring basahin kung ano talaga ang ipinasa, binago at ipinasyahan sa pamamagitan.

Pinapayagan ng Artikulo 85-1 ng Government Procurement Act na dalhin sa Complaint Review Board for Government Procurement ang alitan sa pagganap ng kontrata para sa pamamagitan. Hindi maaaring tanggihan ng pampublikong entidad ang aplikasyon ng supplier para rito.

Inaatasan ang board na magbigay ng rekomendasyon o panukala sa alitan para sa construction works o technical services; kung nabigo ang pamamagitan dahil hindi iyon tinanggap ng entidad, hindi nito maaaring tanggihan ang pagdala ng supplier sa arbitrasyon. Ito ang natatanging pahintulot sa batas.

Sa kaso ng ospital, walang natagpuang napagkasunduang arbitration clause at hindi rin natugunan ang mga katotohanang kailangan para sa pahintulot na iyon. Ang kawalan ng kasunduan sa arbitrasyon ang batayan ng pagpapawalang-bisa sa ilalim ng Artikulo 40(1)(2) ng Arbitration Act.

Ang natatanging daan sa arbitrasyon sa Artikulo 85-1 ay para sa construction works o technical services; hindi awtomatikong saklaw nito ang bawat pagbili ng kagamitan o ibang kontrata ng sektor pampubliko. Sa mismong kontrata, maaari namang may hiwalay na arbitration clause na may bisa.

Inilalarawan ng ulat ng US International Trade Administration noong 30 Setyembre 2026 ang inaasahang procurement para sa kuryente at grid sa Taiwan sa huling bahagi ng 2026 at sa 2027, kabilang ang mga oportunidad para sa mga supplier ng US. Hindi pinatutunayan ng ulat na nakabukas na ang isang partikular na tender, kuwalipikado ang isang kompanya, o construction works o technical services ang magiging kontrata nito.

Para sa bidder, bahagi ng paunang pagsusuri ang dispute clause at kategorya ng procurement. Kapag may kaso nang antala sa iskedyul, mahalaga ang pagkakaiba kapag ang kahilingang dagdag na panahon ay naging habol na rin sa karagdagang gastos. Maaaring iisang problema sa negosyo ang tingin ng claims team, samantalang magkaibang remedyo ang makikita sa mga dokumento.

Natugunan na ba ng board ang habol sa bayad na balak dalhin sa arbitrasyon? Dito magiging gamit ang aplikasyon at mga pagbabago nito, rekomendasyon o panukala, sagot ng entidad, at balak na arbitration demand. Ang pangkalahatang pahayag na “nabigo ang pamamagitan” ay hindi sapat upang maipakita ang pagtutugmang iyon.

The contractor's request changed during mediation:

| Stage | Relief and procedural record |
|---|---|

| Amended application | The claim became a request for an extension of time. |

The US International Trade Administration's [September 30, 2026 energy report](https://www.trade.gov/market-intelligence/taiwan-energy-industry) describes anticipated Taiwanese power and grid procurements in late 2026 and 2027, including opportunities for US suppliers. A claims team may regard both as the same commercial problem while the procedural record identifies different relief.

The answer should come from the application and its amendments, the recommendation or proposal, the entity's response and the intended arbitration demand. A general statement that “mediation failed” leaves out the comparison that mattered in this judgment.

Changing a figure does not necessarily create a different dispute. Neither does refining a legal argument. Conversely, reusing the same project number does not answer the question. The scope requires a reading of the actual facts and relief; the 2017 decision concerned the documented move between time relief and monetary compensation.

When those documents leave a gap, counsel can assess whether an agreed arbitration basis exists or whether further mediation is needed for the proposed claim. A [Taiwan contract-dispute inquiry](/en/contact) can start with the project category, the relief sought and the next procedural date. The file to assemble is the sequence of applications, amendments and responses that led to the unsuccessful mediation.

Statutory consent has those limits. In the hospital case, the court found neither an agreed arbitration clause nor the facts needed for statutory consent. The court identified the absence of an arbitration agreement under Arbitration Act Article 40(1)(2) as the ground for annulment.

Contract classification comes first. Today's Article 85-1 covers construction works and technical services; that does not place every equipment purchase or other public-sector contract within this particular route. A separate arbitration clause may already govern.

The US International Trade Administration's September 30, 2026 energy report describes anticipated Taiwanese power and grid procurements in late 2026 and 2027, including opportunities for US suppliers. These are planned opportunities. The report does not establish that a particular tender has opened, that a company qualifies or that its eventual contract will count as construction or technical services.

Changing a figure does not necessarily create a different dispute. Neither does refining a legal argument. Conversely, reusing the same project number does not answer the question. The scope requires a reading of the actual facts and relief; the 2017 decision concerned the documented move between time relief and monetary compensation.

Sa kaso ng ospital, walang natagpuang napagkasunduang arbitration clause at hindi rin natugunan ang mga katotohanang kailangan para sa pahintulot na iyon. Ang kawalan ng kasunduan sa arbitrasyon ang batayan ng pagpapawalang-bisa sa ilalim ng Artikulo 40(1)(2) ng Arbitration Act.

Mga planong oportunidad iyon. Hindi pinatutunayan ng ulat na nakabukas na ang isang partikular na tender, kuwalipikado ang isang kompanya, o construction works o technical services ang magiging kontrata nito.

targetFields.text: Polusyon ng pabrika sa Taiwan: kaalaman, kontrol at pananagutan ng parent company
Pananagutan ng parent company sa polusyon sa Taiwan

Inugnay ng isang desisyon ng Supreme Court ang pananagutan ng mga parent company sa kontrol, kaalaman sa kontaminasyon, kakulangan ng tugon at paglilipat ng ari-arian. Ipinaliwanag rin nito kung bakit iba ang resulta para sa 246 at 262 claimants.
Bote ng sample ng lupa at kuwaderno sa folding table sa labas ng lumang pabrika
Kathang-isip na eksena
Ang pagmamay-ari ba ng subsidiary sa Taiwan ay awtomatikong nagpapanagot sa dayuhang parent sa mga habol sa polusyon?

Hindi pagmamay-ari lamang ang batayan ng desisyong tinalakay rito. Binanggit sa paliwanag ng hukuman ang kontrol, kaalaman sa kontaminasyon, kakulangan ng pagtugon o paglalahad nito, at mga paglilipat ng ari-arian na naglalayong umiwas sa pananagutan. Kailangang suriin ang partikular na asal at naaangkop na batas.
Tinapos ba ng 2018 na desisyon ng Supreme Court ang lahat ng habol sa kaso ng polusyon ng pabrika?

Hindi. Pinawalang-bisa at ibinalik ng hukuman ang mga bahaging may kinalaman sa 246 claimants, samantalang ibinasura ang mga apelang may kinalaman sa 262. Magkaiba ang resulta sa magkaibang bahagi ng kaso; hindi nito tinapos ang lahat ng kaugnay na litigasyon.
Anong mga rekord ang dapat panatilihin matapos ang environmental review bago ang acquisition?

Panatilihin ang ulat, listahan ng mga tumanggap, kasunod na tanong, mga desisyon tungkol sa exposure ng manggagawa at remediation, at mga pag-apruba at pagsusuring pinansiyal sa huling paglilipat ng ari-arian. Nakakatulong ang mga ito sa pagsusuri ng kaalaman at asal; ang pagtatago lamang ng file ay hindi katibayan ng pagsunod.

sourcePassages.text: Environmental investigations before an acquisition became part of the evidence against parent companies in a Taiwan factory-pollution case. The Supreme Court connected knowledge of contamination with operational control, the response to the danger and transfers that depleted the Taiwan company's assets. Its official explanation of judgment 107年度台上字第267號 shows why an acquisition review cannot end when the consultant delivers a report.

Issued on August 16, 2018, the decision concerned workers' chemical exposure at an electronics manufacturer and the responsibility of companies controlling that business. It did not impose liability merely because a foreign investor owned a Taiwan subsidiary.

According to the Supreme Court's explanation, the record included environmental surveys identifying contamination, knowledge within the controlling groups, failure to inform workers or remedy the problem, and capital reductions and offshore remittances intended to evade liabilities. The court upheld the reasoning that allowed the relevant claims to reach the controlling companies despite separate corporate identities.

That sequence matters to acquisition counsel. A report's distribution list can identify who knew about the problem. Board papers and operational instructions can show who could decide how to respond. Later remittance approvals may need to be read against both. Treating those records as unrelated workstreams makes the group's own decisions harder to reconstruct.

The report is a starting point. A useful review asks who investigated the exposure concern, what further work was commissioned and how the findings affected decisions about the operating company's resources. It should record unanswered questions as unanswered. An optimistic closing presentation should not erase the underlying technical findings or the people responsible for following them up.

For 246 claimants, the Supreme Court vacated the relevant portions and sent them back for further proceedings. Appeals concerning 262 claimants were dismissed. The remand included shortcomings in the analysis of injury, evidence and authority to pursue claims. Those figures and limits appear in the court's disposition summary.

The split prevents a broad reading of the case. Remand did not decide that all affected people lacked a claim, and the dismissed appeals did not resolve every part of the wider litigation. A transaction team assessing historical exposure needs to identify the particular proceedings and their status before estimating an obligation. A headline about a single court date cannot supply that assessment.

Taiwan's Company Act Article 154 generally limits a shareholder's responsibility to payment for its shares. Paragraph 2 provides an exception where a shareholder abuses the company's legal personality, causes it to incur a specific debt that is clearly difficult to repay, and the circumstances are serious enough to make shareholder liability necessary.

Each condition matters. A shareholder relationship, an unpaid debt or an environmental finding alone does not state the whole statutory test. Nor should the statute be treated as the sole explanation for the court's treatment of historical conduct in the 2018 case. That decision examined the controlling companies' conduct and the basis for looking beyond separate legal identity.

Investors comparing entity structures can find the ordinary starting point in the subsidiary and branch article. The pollution dispute adds a question that incorporation documents cannot answer: how did the group actually use its control when it learned about the risk?
USTR's February 2026 fact sheet describes the two sides' intention to facilitate cross-border investment and possible US support for private investment financing in Taiwan, subject to applicable law.

Before approving a distribution, capital reduction or exit transfer, the relevant decision-makers should have an assessment of identified exposure, unresolved claims and the resources that will remain in the Taiwan company. The legal review must address the proposed transaction itself. No document label establishes that a transfer is lawful, and a report sitting unread in a data room does not establish a response to its findings.

For a Taiwan corporate or disputes inquiry, the initial description can identify the transaction, the Taiwan entity and any scheduled transfer or closing date. Technical reports and sensitive worker information can be handled through an agreed delivery process. The immediate records to preserve are the original findings, the decisions they prompted and the approvals for any subsequent movement of assets.

Official sources checked October 25, 2026. This article examines one identified 2018 ruling through the Supreme Court's explanation and the current statutory provision; it is not a history of every related case or an assessment of a particular investor's liability.

Did the 2018 Supreme Court ruling end every claim in the factory-pollution litigation?

No. The court vacated and remanded the portions concerning 246 claimants and dismissed the appeals concerning 262. The ruling had different outcomes for different portions of the case; it was not the conclusion of all related litigation.

Retain the report, its recipients, follow-up questions, decisions on worker exposure and remediation, and the approvals and financial analysis for later asset transfers. These records help assess knowledge and conduct; keeping a file alone does not establish compliance.

targetPassages.text: Naging bahagi ng ebidensiya laban sa mga parent company ang mga environmental investigation na isinagawa bago ang isang acquisition. Sa kaso ng polusyon ng pabrika sa Taiwan, inugnay ng Supreme Court ang kaalaman sa kontaminasyon sa kontrol sa operasyon, tugon sa panganib, at mga paglilipat na nagbawas ng ari-arian ng kompanya sa Taiwan. Ipinapakita ng opisyal na paliwanag sa 107年度台上字第267號 kung bakit hindi natatapos ang pagsusuri sa acquisition kapag naipasa na ng consultant ang ulat.

Inilabas noong 16 Agosto 2018 ang desisyon. Tinalakay nito ang chemical exposure ng mga manggagawa sa isang electronics manufacturer at ang pananagutan ng mga kompanyang kumokontrol sa negosyo. Hindi ipinataw ang pananagutan dahil lang may pag-aari ang dayuhang mamumuhunan sa isang subsidiary sa Taiwan.

Ayon sa paliwanag ng Supreme Court, kabilang sa rekord ang mga environmental survey na nagtukoy ng kontaminasyon, kaalaman sa loob ng mga controlling group, hindi pagpapaalam sa mga manggagawa o pag-aayos ng problema, at capital reduction at offshore remittance na naglalayong umiwas sa mga pananagutan. Pinanatili ng hukuman ang pangangatwirang nagpahintulot na maabot ng nauugnay na habol ang mga controlling company sa kabila ng hiwalay na legal na pagkakakilanlan.

May saysay ang pagkakasunod na iyon sa acquisition counsel. Maaaring ipakita ng distribution list ng ulat kung sino ang nakakaalam ng problema. Ang mga papel ng board at tagubilin sa operasyon naman ay makatutulong upang matukoy kung sino ang makapagpapasiya sa tugon. Kailangan ding basahin ang mga pag-apruba sa kasunod na remittance kasama ng dalawang pangkat ng rekord na iyon. Kapag pinaghiwalay nang tuluyan, mahihirapang buuin muli ang mga desisyon ng grupo.

Panimulang punto ang ulat. Tatanungin sa mabisang pagsusuri kung sino ang nagpaimbestiga sa exposure, anong karagdagang gawain ang ipinagawa, at paano nakaapekto ang natuklasan sa mga desisyon tungkol sa resources ng operating company. Dapat manatiling nakatala bilang hindi pa nasasagot ang mga tanong na wala pang sagot. Hindi dapat burahin ng magandang closing presentation ang teknikal na natuklasan o ang mga taong responsable sa kasunod na hakbang.

Para sa 246 claimants, pinawalang-bisa ng Supreme Court ang nauugnay na mga bahagi at ibinalik ang mga ito para sa karagdagang paglilitis. Ibinasura naman ang mga apelang may kinalaman sa 262 claimants. Kabilang sa remand ang mga pagkukulang sa pagsusuri ng pinsala, ebidensiya at awtoridad na maghabol. Nasa buod ng disposisyon ng hukuman ang mga bilang at limitasyong ito.

Malinaw ang hating resulta: may remand para sa 246 claimants at ibinasurang mga apelang may kinalaman sa 262 claimants. Hindi ipinasiya sa remand na walang habol ang lahat ng apektado, at hindi natapos sa pagbasura ng mga apela ang buong litigasyon.
Sa pagsusuri ng historical exposure bago ang transaksyon, kailangang tukuyin ang partikular na paglilitis at kalagayan nito bago tantiyahin ang obligasyon. Hindi sapat ang isang petsa ng desisyon.

Karaniwang nililimitahan ng Artikulo 154 ng Company Act ang pananagutan ng shareholder sa pagbabayad para sa mga share nito. Nagtatakda ang ikalawang talata ng eksemsiyon kapag inabuso ng shareholder ang legal na personalidad ng kompanya. Kailangang magresulta ang abuso sa isang tiyak na utang na malinaw na mahirap bayaran, at may malulubhang pangyayari upang maging kinakailangan ang pananagutan ng shareholder.

Magkakasamang kondisyon iyon. Hindi buo ang statutory test kung shareholder relationship, hindi bayad na utang, o environmental finding lamang ang mayroon. Hindi rin dapat gawing iisang makasaysayang batayan ang kasalukuyang Artikulo 154 sa pagtrato ng hukuman noong 2018 sa asal ng mga controlling company. Sinuri ng desisyon ang asal ng mga controlling company at batayan ng pagtunghay lampas sa hiwalay na legal na pagkakakilanlan.
May itinuturong tanong ang alitan na hindi masasagot ng incorporation documents: paano ginamit ng grupo ang kontrol nito nang malaman ang panganib?

Inilalarawan ng fact sheet ng USTR noong Pebrero 2026 ang layunin ng dalawang panig na mapadali ang cross-border investment. Binabanggit din rito ang posibleng suporta ng US sa financing ng pribadong pamumuhunan sa Taiwan kasama ang mga pribadong partner ng US, alinsunod sa naaangkop na batas.

Pahayag iyon ng kondisyonadong layunin. Walang awtomatikong karapatang makakuha ng pondo ang isang investor, at hindi dapat ipalagay na buo at nagkakabisa na ang buong kasunduan. Hindi kapalit ng legal at environmental review ang pahayag tungkol sa posibleng financing.

Bago aprubahan ang distribution, capital reduction o exit transfer, kailangang may pagsusuri ang mga nauugnay na decision-maker sa natukoy na exposure, mga hindi pa nalulutas na habol, at resources na matitira sa kompanya sa Taiwan. Ang mismong iminungkahing transaksyon ang dapat suriin nang legal. Walang label ng dokumento na awtomatikong nagpapatunay na legal ang transfer, at hindi rin katibayan ng tugon ang ulat na nakatago lamang sa data room.

Sa English contact page, maaaring banggitin sa unang pagtatanong ang transaksyon, entidad sa Taiwan, at anumang nakatakdang transfer o closing date. Ang teknikal na ulat at sensitibong impormasyon ng manggagawa ay maaaring ipadala sa napagkasunduang ligtas na paraan. Sa ngayon, ang kailangang panatilihin ay ang orihinal na natuklasan, mga desisyong idinulot nito, at mga pag-apruba sa kasunod na pagkilos ng ari-arian.

Environmental investigations before an acquisition became part of the evidence against parent companies in a Taiwan factory-pollution case. The Supreme Court connected knowledge of contamination with operational control, the response to the danger and transfers that depleted the Taiwan company's assets. Its [official explanation of judgment 107年度台上字第267號](https://jirs.judicial.gov.tw/GNNWS/NNWSS002.asp?id=359523) shows why an acquisition review cannot end when the consultant delivers a report.

Issued on August 16, 2018, the decision concerned workers' chemical exposure at an electronics manufacturer and the responsibility of companies controlling that business. It did not impose liability merely because a foreign investor owned a Taiwan subsidiary.

## Knowledge, control and the movement of assets

According to the [Supreme Court's explanation](https://jirs.judicial.gov.tw/GNNWS/NNWSS002.asp?id=359523), the record included environmental surveys identifying contamination, knowledge within the controlling groups, failure to inform workers or remedy the problem, and capital reductions and offshore remittances intended to evade liabilities. The court upheld the reasoning that allowed the relevant claims to reach the controlling companies despite separate corporate identities.

That sequence matters to acquisition counsel. A report's distribution list can identify who knew about the problem. Board papers and operational instructions can show who could decide how to respond. Later remittance approvals may need to be read against both. Treating those records as unrelated workstreams makes the group's own decisions harder to reconstruct.

The report is a starting point. A useful review asks who investigated the exposure concern, what further work was commissioned and how the findings affected decisions about the operating company's resources. It should record unanswered questions as unanswered. An optimistic closing presentation should not erase the underlying technical findings or the people responsible for following them up.

## The ruling had a divided outcome

For 246 claimants, the Supreme Court vacated the relevant portions and sent them back for further proceedings. Appeals concerning 262 claimants were dismissed. The remand included shortcomings in the analysis of injury, evidence and authority to pursue claims. Those figures and limits appear in the [court's disposition summary](https://jirs.judicial.gov.tw/GNNWS/NNWSS002.asp?id=359523).

The split prevents a broad reading of the case. Remand did not decide that all affected people lacked a claim, and the dismissed appeals did not resolve every part of the wider litigation. A transaction team assessing historical exposure needs to identify the particular proceedings and their status before estimating an obligation. A headline about a single court date cannot supply that assessment.

## Limited liability and its conditions

Taiwan's [Company Act Article 154](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=J0080001&flno=154) generally limits a shareholder's responsibility to payment for its shares. Paragraph 2 provides an exception where a shareholder abuses the company's legal personality, causes it to incur a specific debt that is clearly difficult to repay, and the circumstances are serious enough to make shareholder liability necessary.

Each condition matters. A shareholder relationship, an unpaid debt or an environmental finding alone does not state the whole statutory test. Nor should the statute be treated as the sole explanation for the court's treatment of historical conduct in the 2018 case. That decision examined the controlling companies' conduct and the basis for looking beyond separate legal identity.

Investors comparing entity structures can find the ordinary starting point in the [subsidiary and branch article](/en/columns/taiwan-company-subsidiary-vs-branch). The pollution dispute adds a question that incorporation documents cannot answer: how did the group actually use its control when it learned about the risk?

## A current investment plan needs a response record

[USTR's February 2026 fact sheet](https://ustr.gov/about/policy-offices/press-office/fact-sheets/2026/february/fact-sheet-us-taiwan-agreement-reciprocal-trade) describes the two sides' intention to facilitate cross-border investment and possible US support for private investment financing in Taiwan, subject to applicable law.

Before approving a distribution, capital reduction or exit transfer, the relevant decision-makers should have an assessment of identified exposure, unresolved claims and the resources that will remain in the Taiwan company. The legal review must address the proposed transaction itself. No document label establishes that a transfer is lawful, and a report sitting unread in a data room does not establish a response to its findings.

For a [Taiwan corporate or disputes inquiry](/en/contact), the initial description can identify the transaction, the Taiwan entity and any scheduled transfer or closing date. Technical reports and sensitive worker information can be handled through an agreed delivery process. The immediate records to preserve are the original findings, the decisions they prompted and the approvals for any subsequent movement of assets.

Official sources checked October 25, 2026. This article examines one identified 2018 ruling through the Supreme Court's explanation and the current statutory provision; it is not a history of every related case or an assessment of a particular investor's liability.

- [Supreme Court explanation of 107年度台上字第267號, August 16, 2018](https://jirs.judicial.gov.tw/GNNWS/NNWSS002.asp?id=359523): environmental knowledge, control, asset movements and the split disposition.
- [Company Act, Article 154](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=J0080001&flno=154): limited shareholder liability and the statutory exception for abuse of corporate personality.
- [USTR, February 2026 reciprocal-trade fact sheet](https://ustr.gov/about/policy-offices/press-office/fact-sheets/2026/february/fact-sheet-us-taiwan-agreement-reciprocal-trade): stated intentions concerning cross-border investment.

Naging bahagi ng ebidensiya laban sa mga parent company ang mga environmental investigation na isinagawa bago ang isang acquisition. Sa kaso ng polusyon ng pabrika sa Taiwan, inugnay ng Supreme Court ang kaalaman sa kontaminasyon sa kontrol sa operasyon, tugon sa panganib, at mga paglilipat na nagbawas ng ari-arian ng kompanya sa Taiwan. Ipinapakita ng [opisyal na paliwanag sa 107年度台上字第267號](https://jirs.judicial.gov.tw/GNNWS/NNWSS002.asp?id=359523) kung bakit hindi natatapos ang pagsusuri sa acquisition kapag naipasa na ng consultant ang ulat.

Inilabas noong 16 Agosto 2018 ang desisyon. Tinalakay nito ang chemical exposure ng mga manggagawa sa isang electronics manufacturer at ang pananagutan ng mga kompanyang kumokontrol sa negosyo. Hindi ipinataw ang pananagutan dahil lang may pag-aari ang dayuhang mamumuhunan sa isang subsidiary sa Taiwan.

## Kaalaman, kontrol at pagkilos ng ari-arian

Ayon sa [paliwanag ng Supreme Court](https://jirs.judicial.gov.tw/GNNWS/NNWSS002.asp?id=359523), kabilang sa rekord ang mga environmental survey na nagtukoy ng kontaminasyon, kaalaman sa loob ng mga controlling group, hindi pagpapaalam sa mga manggagawa o pag-aayos ng problema, at capital reduction at offshore remittance na naglalayong umiwas sa mga pananagutan. Pinanatili ng hukuman ang pangangatwirang nagpahintulot na maabot ng nauugnay na habol ang mga controlling company sa kabila ng hiwalay na legal na pagkakakilanlan.

May saysay ang pagkakasunod na iyon sa acquisition counsel. Maaaring ipakita ng distribution list ng ulat kung sino ang nakakaalam ng problema. Ang mga papel ng board at tagubilin sa operasyon naman ay makatutulong upang matukoy kung sino ang makapagpapasiya sa tugon. Kailangan ding basahin ang mga pag-apruba sa kasunod na remittance kasama ng dalawang pangkat ng rekord na iyon. Kapag pinaghiwalay nang tuluyan, mahihirapang buuin muli ang mga desisyon ng grupo.

Panimulang punto ang ulat. Tatanungin sa mabisang pagsusuri kung sino ang nagpaimbestiga sa exposure, anong karagdagang gawain ang ipinagawa, at paano nakaapekto ang natuklasan sa mga desisyon tungkol sa resources ng operating company. Dapat manatiling nakatala bilang hindi pa nasasagot ang mga tanong na wala pang sagot. Hindi dapat burahin ng magandang closing presentation ang teknikal na natuklasan o ang mga taong responsable sa kasunod na hakbang.

## Magkaibang resulta para sa mga claimants

Para sa 246 claimants, pinawalang-bisa ng Supreme Court ang nauugnay na mga bahagi at ibinalik ang mga ito para sa karagdagang paglilitis. Ibinasura naman ang mga apelang may kinalaman sa 262 claimants. Kabilang sa remand ang mga pagkukulang sa pagsusuri ng pinsala, ebidensiya at awtoridad na maghabol. Nasa [buod ng disposisyon ng hukuman](https://jirs.judicial.gov.tw/GNNWS/NNWSS002.asp?id=359523) ang mga bilang at limitasyong ito.

Malinaw ang hating resulta: may remand para sa 246 claimants at ibinasurang mga apelang may kinalaman sa 262 claimants. Hindi ipinasiya sa remand na walang habol ang lahat ng apektado, at hindi natapos sa pagbasura ng mga apela ang buong litigasyon.

Sa pagsusuri ng historical exposure bago ang transaksyon, kailangang tukuyin ang partikular na paglilitis at kalagayan nito bago tantiyahin ang obligasyon. Hindi sapat ang isang petsa ng desisyon.

## Limited liability at mga kondisyon ng eksemsiyon

Karaniwang nililimitahan ng [Artikulo 154 ng Company Act](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=J0080001&flno=154) ang pananagutan ng shareholder sa pagbabayad para sa mga share nito. Nagtatakda ang ikalawang talata ng eksemsiyon kapag inabuso ng shareholder ang legal na personalidad ng kompanya. Kailangang magresulta ang abuso sa isang tiyak na utang na malinaw na mahirap bayaran, at may malulubhang pangyayari upang maging kinakailangan ang pananagutan ng shareholder.

Magkakasamang kondisyon iyon. Hindi buo ang statutory test kung shareholder relationship, hindi bayad na utang, o environmental finding lamang ang mayroon. Hindi rin dapat gawing iisang makasaysayang batayan ang kasalukuyang Artikulo 154 sa pagtrato ng hukuman noong 2018 sa asal ng mga controlling company. Sinuri ng desisyon ang asal ng mga controlling company at batayan ng pagtunghay lampas sa hiwalay na legal na pagkakakilanlan.

May itinuturong tanong ang alitan na hindi masasagot ng incorporation documents: paano ginamit ng grupo ang kontrol nito nang malaman ang panganib?

## Tugon sa natuklasan bago ilipat ang ari-arian

Inilalarawan ng [fact sheet ng USTR noong Pebrero 2026](https://ustr.gov/about/policy-offices/press-office/fact-sheets/2026/february/fact-sheet-us-taiwan-agreement-reciprocal-trade) ang layunin ng dalawang panig na mapadali ang cross-border investment. Binabanggit din rito ang posibleng suporta ng US sa financing ng pribadong pamumuhunan sa Taiwan kasama ang mga pribadong partner ng US, alinsunod sa naaangkop na batas.

Pahayag iyon ng kondisyonadong layunin. Walang awtomatikong karapatang makakuha ng pondo ang isang investor, at hindi dapat ipalagay na buo at nagkakabisa na ang buong kasunduan. Hindi kapalit ng legal at environmental review ang pahayag tungkol sa posibleng financing.

Bago aprubahan ang distribution, capital reduction o exit transfer, kailangang may pagsusuri ang mga nauugnay na decision-maker sa natukoy na exposure, mga hindi pa nalulutas na habol, at resources na matitira sa kompanya sa Taiwan. Ang mismong iminungkahing transaksyon ang dapat suriin nang legal. Walang label ng dokumento na awtomatikong nagpapatunay na legal ang transfer, at hindi rin katibayan ng tugon ang ulat na nakatago lamang sa data room.

Sa [English contact page](/en/contact), maaaring banggitin sa unang pagtatanong ang transaksyon, entidad sa Taiwan, at anumang nakatakdang transfer o closing date. Ang teknikal na ulat at sensitibong impormasyon ng manggagawa ay maaaring ipadala sa napagkasunduang ligtas na paraan. Sa ngayon, ang kailangang panatilihin ay ang orihinal na natuklasan, mga desisyong idinulot nito, at mga pag-apruba sa kasunod na pagkilos ng ari-arian.

Sinuri ang mga opisyal na sanggunian noong 25–26 Oktubre 2026. Batay ang artikulong ito sa opisyal na paliwanag ng Supreme Court sa tiyak na 2018 na desisyon at sa kasalukuyang statutory provision; hindi ito kasaysayan ng bawat kaugnay na kaso o pagsusuri ng pananagutan ng partikular na investor.

- [Company Act, Artikulo 154](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=J0080001&flno=154): limitadong pananagutan ng shareholder at eksemsiyon para sa abuso ng corporate personality.
- [USTR, fact sheet sa reciprocal trade, Pebrero 2026](https://ustr.gov/about/policy-offices/press-office/fact-sheets/2026/february/fact-sheet-us-taiwan-agreement-reciprocal-trade): mga nakasaad na layunin tungkol sa cross-border investment.

targetFields.text: Klaim proyek pemerintah Taiwan berubah sebelum arbitrase: akibatnya bagi putusan
Mediasi dan arbitrase kontrak pemerintah Taiwan
Putusan arbitrase proyek rumah sakit Taiwan dibatalkan setelah permintaan ganti uang mengikuti mediasi mengenai perpanjangan waktu. Rekam mediasi harus mencakup sengketa yang diajukan ke arbitrase.
Helm proyek, gambar konstruksi, dan binder di samping model jembatan.
Adegan fiksi
Apakah mediasi yang gagal otomatis membuka arbitrase melawan instansi publik Taiwan?

Tidak. Untuk pekerjaan konstruksi dan jasa teknis, jalur menurut undang-undang mensyaratkan kegagalan mediasi karena instansi tidak menyetujui rekomendasi atau usulan badan pengadaan. Sengketa konkret yang dibawa ke arbitrase harus dibandingkan dengan catatan mediasi. Perjanjian arbitrase tersendiri dapat menjadi dasar lain.

source.title: When a Taiwan Public-Works Claim Changes Before Arbitration
source.summary: A contractor lost a Taiwan public-works award after changing its claim. Failed mediation must cover the dispute that relies on the statutory arbitration route.

faq.q: Does unsuccessful mediation automatically allow arbitration against a Taiwan public entity?
faq.a: No. The statutory route for construction works and technical services requires unsuccessful mediation because the entity did not agree to the procurement review board's recommendation or proposal. The concrete dispute submitted to arbitration must be assessed against that mediation record. A separate arbitration agreement may provide another basis.

faq.q: Did the Supreme Court decide that every change in a claim defeats arbitration?
faq.a: No. This case involved a return to a money claim after a recommendation concerning an extension of time. It does not establish that every revised amount or legal argument creates a different dispute. The facts, relief and procedural documents need comparison.

sourcePassages.text: An arbitration award for NT$44,417,150 did not survive a Taiwan hospital contractor's court proceedings. The contractor had obtained a mediation recommendation about extra time, then pursued money in arbitration without a recommendation on that changed claim. On July 12, 2017, the Supreme Court dismissed the contractor's appeal. The annulment stood. Its explanation expressly records that the case was final. The problem was the absence of an agreed or statutorily deemed arbitration agreement for the concrete money dispute.
The contractor's request changed during mediation:
Stage
Relief and procedural record
Initial application
Monetary compensation was sought.
Amended application
The claim became a request for an extension of time.
Board recommendation
The board addressed the extension; the public entity did not agree.
Later claim
The contractor returned to monetary compensation, which received no recommendation or proposal before arbitration.

A certificate of unsuccessful mediation did not fill the gap. As the court explained, the entity needed an opportunity to accept or reject a recommendation on the particular dispute. The Supreme Court corrected the lower court's reasoning about which version of the law applied, while preserving its decision to annul the award.

Government Procurement Act Article 85-1 allows contract-performance disputes to be taken to the Complaint Review Board for Government Procurement for mediation. A public entity cannot refuse a supplier's mediation application. For construction works and technical services, the board must offer a mediation recommendation or proposal; if mediation fails because the entity disagrees with it, the entity cannot refuse the supplier's referral to arbitration.

Statutory consent has those limits. In the hospital case, the court found neither an agreed arbitration clause nor the facts needed for statutory consent. The court identified the absence of an arbitration agreement under Arbitration Act Article 40(1)(2) as the ground for annulment.

Contract classification comes first. Today's Article 85-1 covers construction works and technical services; that does not place every equipment purchase or other public-sector contract within this particular route. A separate arbitration clause may already govern.

The US International Trade Administration's September 30, 2026 energy report describes anticipated Taiwanese power and grid procurements in late 2026 and 2027, including opportunities for US suppliers. These are planned opportunities. The report does not establish that a particular tender has opened, that a company qualifies or that its eventual contract will count as construction or technical services.

For a bidder, the dispute clause and procurement category belong in the initial contract review. For a contractor already facing delay, the distinction becomes practical when a schedule request develops into a claim for additional costs. A claims team may regard both as the same commercial problem while the procedural record identifies different relief.

Has the board addressed the payment claim now being drafted for arbitration? The answer should come from the application and its amendments, the recommendation or proposal, the entity's response and the intended arbitration demand. A general statement that “mediation failed” leaves out the comparison that mattered in this judgment.

Changing a figure does not necessarily create a different dispute. Neither does refining a legal argument. Conversely, reusing the same project number does not answer the question. The scope requires a reading of the actual facts and relief; the 2017 decision concerned the documented move between time relief and monetary compensation.

When those documents leave a gap, counsel can assess whether an agreed arbitration basis exists or whether further mediation is needed for the proposed claim. A Taiwan contract-dispute inquiry can start with the project category, the relief sought and the next procedural date. The file to assemble is the sequence of applications, amendments and responses that led to the unsuccessful mediation.
